verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is background monitors: you can ask Grok to watch a log or a port (e.g. "watch the deploy logs and tell me if anything errors"), and each line the script prints becomes a notification in the conversation. Generic MCP support lets external tools plug in, but no browser or debugger tool is documented. That gives log and port observation of a running app, not real live debugging. Missing for 10: attaching a debugger or browser devtools to a running web app, inspecting runtime state/DOM/network requests, breakpoints, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
